```typescript
      return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    }
  }

  private loadCachedStars(): StarStatus | null {
    if (!existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) return null
    try {
      const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
      return cached.stars || null
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }

  private saveStarsCache(year: number, stars: StarStatus): void {
    try {
      writeFileSync(
        STARS_CACHE_FILE,
        JSON.stringify({ year, stars, timestamp: Date.now() }, null, 2),
        "utf-8"
      )
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore cache write errors
    }
  }

  markStarComplete(year: number, day: number, part: 1 | 2): void {
    const cached = this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    if (!cached[day]) {
      cached[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }
    }
    cached[day][part === 1 ? "part1" : "part2"] = true
    this.saveStarsCache(year, cached)
  }

  async submitAnswer(year: number, day: number, part: 1 | 2, answer: string | number): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const client = this
    // Rate limiting
    const now = Date.now()
    const timeSinceLastSubmission = now - this.lastSubmissionTime
    if (timeSinceLastSubmission < RATE_LIMIT_MS) {
      const waitTime = RATE_LIMIT_MS - timeSinceLastSubmission
      console.log(`⏳ Rate limit: waiting ${Math.ceil(waitTime / 1000)} seconds...`)
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime))
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}/answer`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
        },
        body: `level=${part}&answer=${encodeURIComponent(String(answer))}`,
      })

      this.lastSubmissionTime = Date.now()

      if (!response.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
        }
      }

      const html = await response.text()

      // Parse response
      if (html.includes("That's the right answer")) {
        // Mark as complete in cache
        this.markStarComplete(year, day, part)
        return { success: true, message: "✅ Correct answer!" }
      } else if (html.includes("That's not the right answer")) {
        const tooLow = html.includes("too low")
        const tooHigh = html.includes("too high")
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `❌ Wrong answer${tooLow ? " (too low)" : tooHigh ? " (too high)" : ""}`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You gave an answer too recently")) {
        const waitMatch = html.match(/You have ([\d]+) ([\w]+) left to wait/)
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `⏳ Too soon! ${waitMatch ? waitMatch[0] : "Please wait before submitting again."}`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You don't seem to be solving the right level")) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "⚠️ Part 1 must be completed before Part 2",
        }
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "❓ Unknown response from server",
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Error: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
      }
    }
  }
}

class AnswerParser {
  static parse(output: string): { part1?: string; part2?: string } {
    const result: { part1?: string; part2?: string } = {}

    // Try various patterns
    const patterns = [
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
      /^(\d+)$/m, // Just a number on its own line
    ]

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part1 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    const part2Patterns = [
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
    ]

    for (const pattern of part2Patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part2 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    return result
  }
}

class SolutionRunner {
  static run(day: number, year: number): string {
    // Try different file naming patterns
    const dayStr = String(day).padStart(2, "0")
    const cwd = process.cwd()
    const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
    const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")
    
    const possiblePaths = [
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.ts`),
    ]
    
    const codePath = possiblePaths.find(p => existsSync(p))
    
    if (!codePath) {
      throw new Error(`Solution file not found. Tried:\n${possiblePaths.map(p => `  - ${p}`).join("\n")}`)
    }

    try {
      // Use tsx to run TypeScript directly
      const output = execSync(`tsx "${codePath}"`, {
        cwd: process.cwd(),
        encoding: "utf-8",
        stdio: "pipe",
      })

      return output
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(`Execution failed: ${error.message}\n${error.stdout || ""}\n${error.stderr || ""}`)
    }
  }
}

function parseArgs(): HarnessConfig {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2)
  const config: HarnessConfig = {
    day: 1,
    submit: false,
    print: true,
    auto: false,
    year: 2025,
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {

    const nextArg = args[i + 1]

    switch (arg) {

        i++

        config.part = parseInt(nextArg, 10) as 1 | 2
        i++

      case "--submit":

        config.submit = true
        break
      case "--print":
        config.print = true
        break
      case "--auto":
      case "-a":
        config.auto = true
        break
      case "--year":
      case "-y":
        config.year = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--help":
      case "-h":
        console.log(`
Advent of Code Harness

Usage:
  tsx harness.ts [options]

Options:
  --day, -d <number>     Day to run (1-25)
  --part, -p <number>    Part to run (1 or 2)
  --submit, -s           Submit answer to AoC
  --print                 Print answer (default: true)
  --auto, -a              Auto-detect and submit both parts
  --year, -y <number>     Year (default: 2025)
  --help, -h              Show this help

Examples:
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --print
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --submit
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto
        `)
        process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  return config
}
```

```typescript
#!/usr/bin/env tsx

/**
 * Advent of Code Harness
 * 
 * Automates running solutions, submitting answers, and tracking progress.
 * 
 * Usage:
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --submit
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --print
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto  # Auto-detect and submit both parts
 */

import { execSync } from "child_process"
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "fs"
import { join } from "path"

const AOC_SESSION = "<REDACTED>
const AOC_BASE_URL = "https://adventofcode.com"
const RATE_LIMIT_MS = 60000 // 1 minute between submissions

interface HarnessConfig {
  day: number
  part?: 1 | 2
  submit: boolean
  print: boolean
  auto: boolean
  year: number
}

interface StarStatus {
  [day: number]: {
    part1: boolean
    part2: boolean
  }
}

const getCachePath = () => {
  const cwd = process.cwd()
  const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
  const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")
  return join(basePath, ".stars-cache.json")
}
const STARS_CACHE_FILE = getCachePath()

class AOCClient {
  private lastSubmissionTime = 0
  private sessionCookie: string

  constructor(sessionCookie: string) {
    this.sessionCookie = sessionCookie
  }

  async getStars(year: number, useCache = true): Promise<StarStatus> {
    // Try to load from cache first
    if (useCache && existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) {
      try {
        const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
        if (cached.year === year && cached.timestamp > Date.now() - 3600000) {
          // Cache is less than 1 hour old
          return cached.stars || {}
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // Cache invalid, continue to fetch
      }
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}`, {
        headers: {
          Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
        },
      })

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.warn(`Failed to fetch stars: ${response.statusText}`)
        return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
      }

      const html = await response.text()
      const status: StarStatus = {}

      // Parse HTML to find completed days
      // AoC calendar shows stars with specific classes
      for (let day = 1; day <= 25; day++) {
        status[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }
        
        // Look for day completion indicators
        // Pattern: calendar-daycomplete or similar indicators
        const dayRegex = new RegExp(`(?:calendar-daycomplete|calendar-verycomplete).*?day-${day}`, "gi")
        const matches = html.match(dayRegex)
        
        if (matches) {
          // Check for completion indicators
          const completeCount = matches.length
          status[day].part1 = completeCount >= 1
          status[day].part2 = completeCount >= 2
        }
      }

      // Save to cache
      this.saveStarsCache(year, status)

      return status
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Error fetching stars: ${error}`)
      return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    }
  }

  private loadCachedStars(): StarStatus | null {
    if (!existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) return null
    try {
      const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
      return cached.stars || null
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }

  private saveStarsCache(year: number, stars: StarStatus): void {
    try {
      writeFileSync(
        STARS_CACHE_FILE,
        JSON.stringify({ year, stars, timestamp: Date.now() }, null, 2),
        "utf-8"
      )
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore cache write errors
    }
  }

  markStarComplete(year: number, day: number, part: 1 | 2): void {
    const cached = this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    if (!cached[day]) {
      cached[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }
    }
    cached[day][part === 1 ? "part1" : "part2"] = true
    this.saveStarsCache(year, cached)
  }

  async submitAnswer(year: number, day: number, part: 1 | 2, answer: string | number): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const client = this
    // Rate limiting
    const now = Date.now()
    const timeSinceLastSubmission = now - this.lastSubmissionTime
    if (timeSinceLastSubmission < RATE_LIMIT_MS) {
      const waitTime = RATE_LIMIT_MS - timeSinceLastSubmission
      console.log(`⏳ Rate limit: waiting ${Math.ceil(waitTime / 1000)} seconds...`)
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime))
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}/answer`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
        },
        body: `level=${part}&answer=${encodeURIComponent(String(answer))}`,
      })

      this.lastSubmissionTime = Date.now()

      if (!response.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
        }
      }

      const html = await response.text()

      // Parse response
      if (html.includes("That's the right answer")) {
        // Mark as complete in cache
        this.markStarComplete(year, day, part)
        return { success: true, message: "✅ Correct answer!" }
      } else if (html.includes("That's not the right answer")) {
        const tooLow = html.includes("too low")
        const tooHigh = html.includes("too high")
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `❌ Wrong answer${tooLow ? " (too low)" : tooHigh ? " (too high)" : ""}`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You gave an answer too recently")) {
        const waitMatch = html.match(/You have ([\d]+) ([\w]+) left to wait/)
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `⏳ Too soon! ${waitMatch ? waitMatch[0] : "Please wait before submitting again."}`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You don't seem to be solving the right level")) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "⚠️ Part 1 must be completed before Part 2",
        }
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "❓ Unknown response from server",
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Error: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
      }
    }
  }
}

class AnswerParser {
  static parse(output: string): { part1?: string; part2?: string } {

    const patterns = [

}
```

## Advent of Code harness

### Features

1. Run solutions — Executes TypeScript solutions automatically
2. Submit answers — Submits to AoC API with rate limiting (1 per minute)
3. Star tracking — Caches completion status and skips completed days/parts
4. Auto mode — Detects and submits both parts automatically
5. Answer parsing — Extracts Part 1/Part 2 from console output

### Usage examples

```bash
# Just print the answer (no submission)
npx tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --print

# Submit an answer
npx tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --submit

# Auto-detect and submit both parts
npx tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto

# Or use npm scripts
npm run harness -- --day 1 --part 1
```

### What it does

- Respects rate limits (waits 1 minute between submissions)
- Tracks stars locally (caches in `.stars-cache.json`)
- Skips already-completed days/parts
- Handles multiple file naming patterns (`day01.code.ts`, `day01.ts`, etc.)
- Runs solutions from the correct directory so input files are found
- Parses answers from console output automatically

### Files created

- `harness.ts` — Main harness script
- `package.json` — Dependencies and scripts
- `tsconfig.json` — TypeScript configuration
- `README.md` — Documentation
- `.gitignore` — Ignores cache and node_modules

```typescript
#!/usr/bin/env tsx

/**
 * Advent of Code Harness
 *
 * Automates running solutions, submitting answers, and tracking progress.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --submit
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --print
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto  # Auto-detect and submit both parts
 */

import { execSync } from "child_process"
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "fs"
import { join } from "path"
import { config } from "dotenv"

// Load environment variables from .env file
config()

const AOC_SESSION =
  process.env.AOC_SESSION ||
  "<REDACTED>
const AOC_BASE_URL = process.env.AOC_BASE_URL || "https://adventofcode.com"
const RATE_LIMIT_MS = parseInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_MS || "60000", 10)

interface HarnessConfig {
  day: number
  part?: 1 | 2
  submit: boolean
  print: boolean
  auto: boolean
  year: number
}

interface StarStatus {
  [day: number]: {
    part1: boolean
    part2: boolean
  }
}

const getCachePath = () => {
  const cwd = process.cwd()
  const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
  const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")
  return join(basePath, ".stars-cache.json")
}
const STARS_CACHE_FILE = getCachePath()

class AOCClient {
  private lastSubmissionTime = 0
  private sessionCookie: string

  constructor(sessionCookie: string) {
    this.sessionCookie = sessionCookie
  }

  async getStars(year: number, useCache = true): Promise<StarStatus> {
    // Try to load from cache first
    if (useCache && existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) {
      try {
        const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
        if (cached.year === year && cached.timestamp > Date.now() - 3600000) {
          // Cache is less than 1 hour old
          return cached.stars || {}
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // Cache invalid, continue to fetch
      }
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}`, {
        headers: {
          Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
        },
      })

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.warn(`Failed to fetch stars: ${response.statusText}`)
        return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
      }

      const html = await response.text()
      const status: StarStatus = {}

      // Parse HTML to find completed days
      // AoC calendar shows stars with specific classes
      for (let day = 1; day <= 25; day++) {
        status[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }

        // Look for day completion indicators
        // Pattern: calendar-daycomplete or similar indicators
        const dayRegex = new RegExp(
          `(?:calendar-daycomplete|calendar-verycomplete).*?day-${day}`,
          "gi"
        )
        const matches = html.match(dayRegex)

        if (matches) {
          // Check for completion indicators
          const completeCount = matches.length
          status[day].part1 = completeCount >= 1
          status[day].part2 = completeCount >= 2
        }
      }

      // Save to cache
      this.saveStarsCache(year, status)

      return status
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Error fetching stars: ${error}`)
      return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    }
  }

  private loadCachedStars(): StarStatus | null {
    if (!existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) return null
    try {
      const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
      return cached.stars || null
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }

  private saveStarsCache(year: number, stars: StarStatus): void {
    try {
      writeFileSync(
        STARS_CACHE_FILE,
        JSON.stringify({ year, stars, timestamp: Date.now() }, null, 2),
        "utf-8"
      )
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore cache write errors
    }
  }

  markStarComplete(year: number, day: number, part: 1 | 2): void {
    const cached = this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    if (!cached[day]) {
      cached[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }
    }
    cached[day][part === 1 ? "part1" : "part2"] = true
    this.saveStarsCache(year, cached)
  }

  async submitAnswer(
    year: number,
    day: number,
    part: 1 | 2,
    answer: string | number
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const client = this
    // Rate limiting
    const now = Date.now()
    const timeSinceLastSubmission = now - this.lastSubmissionTime
    if (timeSinceLastSubmission < RATE_LIMIT_MS) {
      const waitTime = RATE_LIMIT_MS - timeSinceLastSubmission
      console.log(
        `⏳ Rate limit: waiting ${Math.ceil(waitTime / 1000)} seconds...`
      )
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime))
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}/answer`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
          },
          body: `level=${part}&answer=${encodeURIComponent(String(answer))}`,
        }
      )

      this.lastSubmissionTime = Date.now()

      if (!response.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
        }
      }

      const html = await response.text()

      // Parse response
      if (html.includes("That's the right answer")) {
        // Mark as complete in cache
        this.markStarComplete(year, day, part)
        return { success: true, message: "✅ Correct answer!" }
      } else if (html.includes("That's not the right answer")) {
        const tooLow = html.includes("too low")
        const tooHigh = html.includes("too high")
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `❌ Wrong answer${
            tooLow ? " (too low)" : tooHigh ? " (too high)" : ""
          }`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You gave an answer too recently")) {
        const waitMatch = html.match(/You have ([\d]+) ([\w]+) left to wait/)
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `⏳ Too soon! ${
            waitMatch ? waitMatch[0] : "Please wait before submitting again."
          }`,
        }
      } else if (
        html.includes("You don't seem to be solving the right level")
      ) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "⚠️ Part 1 must be completed before Part 2",
        }
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "❓ Unknown response from server",
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Error: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }`,
      }
    }
  }
}

class AnswerParser {
  static parse(output: string): { part1?: string; part2?: string } {
    const result: { part1?: string; part2?: string } = {}

    // Try various patterns
    const patterns = [
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
      /^(\d+)$/m, // Just a number on its own line
    ]

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part1 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    const part2Patterns = [
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
    ]

    for (const pattern of part2Patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part2 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    return result
  }
}

class SolutionRunner {
  static run(day: number, year: number): string {
    // Try different file naming patterns
    const dayStr = String(day).padStart(2, "0")
    const cwd = process.cwd()
    const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
    const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")

    const possiblePaths = [
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.ts`),
    ]

    const codePath = possiblePaths.find((p) => existsSync(p))

    if (!codePath) {
      throw new Error(
        `Solution file not found. Tried:\n${possiblePaths
          .map((p) => `  - ${p}`)
          .join("\n")}`
      )
    }

    try {
      // Run from the directory containing the solution file so relative paths work
      const solutionDir = join(codePath, "..")
      const output = execSync(`tsx "${codePath}"`, {
        cwd: solutionDir,
        encoding: "utf-8",
        stdio: "pipe",
      })

      return output
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(
        `Execution failed: ${error.message}\n${error.stdout || ""}\n${
          error.stderr || ""
        }`
      )
    }
  }
}

function parseArgs(): HarnessConfig {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2)
  const config: HarnessConfig = {
    day: 1,
    submit: false,
    print: true,
    auto: false,
    year: 2025,
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const arg = args[i]
    const nextArg = args[i + 1]

    switch (arg) {
      case "--day":
      case "-d":
        config.day = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--part":
      case "-p":
        config.part = parseInt(nextArg, 10) as 1 | 2
        i++
        break
      case "--submit":
      case "-s":
        config.submit = true
        break
      case "--print":
        config.print = true
        break
      case "--auto":
      case "-a":
        config.auto = true
        break
      case "--year":
      case "-y":
        config.year = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--help":
      case "-h":
        console.log(`
Advent of Code Harness

Usage:
  tsx harness.ts [options]

Options:
  --day, -d <number>     Day to run (1-25)
  --part, -p <number>    Part to run (1 or 2)
  --submit, -s           Submit answer to AoC
  --print                 Print answer (default: true)
  --auto, -a              Auto-detect and submit both parts
  --year, -y <number>     Year (default: 2025)
  --help, -h              Show this help

Examples:
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --print
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --submit
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto
        `)
        process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  return config
}

async function main() {
  const config = parseArgs()
  const client = new AOCClient(AOC_SESSION)

  console.log(`🎄 Advent of Code ${config.year} - Day ${config.day}\n`)

  // Check star status
  const stars = await client.getStars(config.year)
  const dayStars = stars[config.day] || { part1: false, part2: false }

  if (dayStars.part1 && dayStars.part2) {
    console.log("⭐ Both parts already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part1 && config.part === 1) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 1 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part2 && config.part === 2) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 2 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  // Run solution
  console.log("🚀 Running solution...")
  let output: string
  try {
    output = SolutionRunner.run(config.day, config.year)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ Failed to run solution: ${error}`)
    process.exit(1)
  }

  // Parse answers
  const answers = AnswerParser.parse(output)

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (config.print) {
    console.log("\n📊 Output:")
    console.log(output)
    console.log("\n📝 Parsed answers:")
    if (answers.part1) console.log(`  Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
    if (answers.part2) console.log(`  Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
  }

  // Submit if requested
  if (config.submit || config.auto) {
    if (config.auto) {
      // Submit both parts if we have answers
      if (answers.part1 && !dayStars.part1) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          1,
          answers.part1
        )
        console.log(result.message)

        if (result.success) {
          // Wait before submitting part 2
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, RATE_LIMIT_MS))
        }
      }

      if (answers.part2 && !dayStars.part2) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          2,
          answers.part2
        )
        console.log(result.message)
      }
    } else if (config.part) {
      const answer = config.part === 1 ? answers.part1 : answers.part2
      if (!answer) {
        console.error(`❌ No answer found for Part ${config.part}`)
        process.exit(1)
      }

      console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part ${config.part}: ${answer}`)
      const result = await client.submitAnswer(
        config.year,
        config.day,
        config.part,
        answer
      )
      console.log(result.message)

      if (!result.success && result.message.includes("too recently")) {
        console.log("\n💡 Tip: Wait a minute before trying again")
      }

      if (result.success) {
        console.log(`\n🎉 Part ${config.part} complete!`)
      }
    } else {
      console.error("❌ --part required when using --submit")
      process.exit(1)
    }
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Fatal error:", error)
  process.exit(1)
})
```

```typescript
#!/usr/bin/env tsx

/**
 * Advent of Code Harness
 *
 * Automates running solutions, submitting answers, and tracking progress.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --submit
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --print
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto  # Auto-detect and submit both parts
 */

import { execSync } from "child_process"
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "fs"
import { join } from "path"
import { config } from "dotenv"

// Load environment variables from .env file
config()

const AOC_SESSION =
  process.env.AOC_SESSION ||
  "<REDACTED>
const AOC_BASE_URL = process.env.AOC_BASE_URL || "https://adventofcode.com"
const RATE_LIMIT_MS = parseInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_MS || "60000", 10)

interface HarnessConfig {
  day: number
  part?: 1 | 2
  submit: boolean
  print: boolean
  auto: boolean
  year: number
}

interface StarStatus {
  [day: number]: {
    part1: boolean
    part2: boolean
  }
}

const getCachePath = () => {
  const cwd = process.cwd()
  const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
  const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")
  return join(basePath, ".stars-cache.json")
}
const STARS_CACHE_FILE = getCachePath()

class AOCClient {
  private lastSubmissionTime = 0
  private sessionCookie: string

  constructor(sessionCookie: string) {
    this.sessionCookie = sessionCookie
  }

  async getStars(year: number, useCache = true): Promise<StarStatus> {
    // Try to load from cache first
    if (useCache && existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) {
      try {
        const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
        if (cached.year === year && cached.timestamp > Date.now() - 3600000) {
          // Cache is less than 1 hour old
          return cached.stars || {}
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // Cache invalid, continue to fetch
      }
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}`, {
        headers: {
          Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
        },
      })

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.warn(`Failed to fetch stars: ${response.statusText}`)
        return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
      }

      const html = await response.text()
      const status: StarStatus = {}

      // Parse HTML to find completed days
      // AoC calendar shows stars in various ways - try multiple patterns
      for (let day = 1; day <= 25; day++) {
        status[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }

        // Pattern 1: Look for calendar completion classes
        // Format: <span class="calendar-daycomplete"> or similar
        const completePatterns = [
          new RegExp(`calendar-daycomplete[^>]*>.*?day-${day}`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`calendar-verycomplete[^>]*>.*?day-${day}`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`day-${day}[^>]*calendar-daycomplete`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`day-${day}[^>]*calendar-verycomplete`, "gi"),
        ]

        let starCount = 0
        for (const pattern of completePatterns) {
          const matches = html.match(pattern)
          if (matches) {
            starCount = Math.max(starCount, matches.length)
          }
        }

        // Pattern 2: Check if the day link shows as completed
        // Look for "Both parts" or completion indicators near the day number
        const dayLinkPattern = new RegExp(
          `day-${day}[^<]*<[^>]*>(?:[^<]*Both parts|.*?\\*\\*)[^<]*`,
          "gi"
        )
        if (dayLinkPattern.test(html)) {
          starCount = Math.max(starCount, 2)
        }

        // Pattern 3: Check individual day page for completion
        // This is more reliable - check the actual day page
        try {
          const dayResponse = await fetch(
            `${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}`,
            {
              headers: {
                Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
              },
            }
          )
          if (dayResponse.ok) {
            const dayHtml = await dayResponse.text()
            // Look for "Both parts of this puzzle are complete" or similar
            if (
              dayHtml.includes("Both parts of this puzzle are complete") ||
              dayHtml.includes("You have completed both parts")
            ) {
              status[day].part1 = true
              status[day].part2 = true
              continue
            }
            // Check for part 1 completion
            if (
              dayHtml.includes("You have completed the first part") ||
              dayHtml.includes("Part 1 complete")
            ) {
              status[day].part1 = true
            }
          }
        } catch (error) {
          // If we can't check individual day, fall back to calendar parsing
        }

        // Use calendar parsing as fallback
        if (starCount > 0) {
          status[day].part1 = starCount >= 1
          status[day].part2 = starCount >= 2
        }
      }

      // Save to cache
      this.saveStarsCache(year, status)

      return status
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Error fetching stars: ${error}`)
      return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    }
  }

  private loadCachedStars(): StarStatus | null {

        // Mark as complete in cache
        this.markStarComplete(year, day, part)
        return { success: true, message: "✅ Correct answer!" }
      } else if (html.includes("That's not the right answer")) {
        const tooLow = html.includes("too low")
        const tooHigh = html.includes("too high")
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `❌ Wrong answer${
            tooLow ? " (too low)" : tooHigh ? " (too high)" : ""
          }`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You gave an answer too recently")) {
        const waitMatch = html.match(/You have ([\d]+) ([\w]+) left to wait/)
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `⏳ Too soon! ${
            waitMatch ? waitMatch[0] : "Please wait before submitting again."
          }`,
        }
      } else if (
        html.includes("You don't seem to be solving the right level")
      ) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "⚠️ Part 1 must be completed before Part 2",
        }
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "❓ Unknown response from server",
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Error: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }`,
      }
    }
  }
}

class AnswerParser {
  static parse(output: string): { part1?: string; part2?: string } {
    const result: { part1?: string; part2?: string } = {}

    // Try various patterns
    const patterns = [
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
      /^(\d+)$/m, // Just a number on its own line
    ]

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part1 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    const part2Patterns = [
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
    ]

    for (const pattern of part2Patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part2 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    return result
  }
}

class SolutionRunner {
  static run(day: number, year: number): string {
    // Try different file naming patterns
    const dayStr = String(day).padStart(2, "0")
    const cwd = process.cwd()
    const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
    const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")

    const possiblePaths = [
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.ts`),
    ]

    const codePath = possiblePaths.find((p) => existsSync(p))

    if (!codePath) {
      throw new Error(
        `Solution file not found. Tried:\n${possiblePaths
          .map((p) => `  - ${p}`)
          .join("\n")}`
      )
    }

    try {
      // Run from the directory containing the solution file so relative paths work
      const solutionDir = join(codePath, "..")
      const output = execSync(`tsx "${codePath}"`, {
        cwd: solutionDir,
        encoding: "utf-8",
        stdio: "pipe",
      })

      return output
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(
        `Execution failed: ${error.message}\n${error.stdout || ""}\n${
          error.stderr || ""
        }`
      )
    }
  }
}

function parseArgs(): HarnessConfig {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2)
  const config: HarnessConfig = {
    day: 1,
    submit: false,
    print: true,
    auto: false,
    year: 2025,
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const arg = args[i]
    const nextArg = args[i + 1]

    switch (arg) {
      case "--day":
      case "-d":
        config.day = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--part":
      case "-p":
        config.part = parseInt(nextArg, 10) as 1 | 2
        i++
        break
      case "--submit":
      case "-s":
        config.submit = true
        break
      case "--print":
        config.print = true
        break
      case "--auto":
      case "-a":
        config.auto = true
        break
      case "--year":
      case "-y":
        config.year = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--help":
      case "-h":
        console.log(`
Advent of Code Harness

Usage:
  tsx harness.ts [options]

Options:
  --day, -d <number>     Day to run (1-25)
  --part, -p <number>    Part to run (1 or 2)
  --submit, -s           Submit answer to AoC
  --print                 Print answer (default: true)
  --auto, -a              Auto-detect and submit both parts
  --year, -y <number>     Year (default: 2025)
  --help, -h              Show this help

Examples:
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --print
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --submit
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto
        `)
        process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  return config
}

async function main() {
  const config = parseArgs()
  const client = new AOCClient(AOC_SESSION)

  console.log(`🎄 Advent of Code ${config.year} - Day ${config.day}\n`)

  // Check star status
  const stars = await client.getStars(config.year)
  const dayStars = stars[config.day] || { part1: false, part2: false }

  if (dayStars.part1 && dayStars.part2) {
    console.log("⭐ Both parts already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part1 && config.part === 1) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 1 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part2 && config.part === 2) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 2 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  // Run solution
  console.log("🚀 Running solution...")
  let output: string
  try {
    output = SolutionRunner.run(config.day, config.year)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ Failed to run solution: ${error}`)
    process.exit(1)
  }

  // Parse answers
  const answers = AnswerParser.parse(output)

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (config.print) {
    console.log("\n📊 Output:")
    console.log(output)
    console.log("\n📝 Parsed answers:")
    if (answers.part1) console.log(`  Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
    if (answers.part2) console.log(`  Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
  }

  // Submit if requested
  if (config.submit || config.auto) {
    if (config.auto) {
      // Submit both parts if we have answers
      if (answers.part1 && !dayStars.part1) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          1,
          answers.part1
        )
        console.log(result.message)

        if (result.success) {
          // Wait before submitting part 2
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, RATE_LIMIT_MS))
        }
      }

      if (answers.part2 && !dayStars.part2) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          2,
          answers.part2
        )
        console.log(result.message)
      }
    } else if (config.part) {
      const answer = config.part === 1 ? answers.part1 : answers.part2
      if (!answer) {
        console.error(`❌ No answer found for Part ${config.part}`)
        process.exit(1)
      }

      console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part ${config.part}: ${answer}`)
      const result = await client.submitAnswer(
        config.year,
        config.day,
        config.part,
        answer
      )
      console.log(result.message)

      if (!result.success && result.message.includes("too recently")) {
        console.log("\n💡 Tip: Wait a minute before trying again")
      }

      if (result.success) {
        console.log(`\n🎉 Part ${config.part} complete!`)
      }
    } else {
      console.error("❌ --part required when using --submit")
      process.exit(1)
    }
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Fatal error:", error)
  process.exit(1)
})
```

```typescript
#!/usr/bin/env tsx

/**
 * Advent of Code Harness
 *
 * Automates running solutions, submitting answers, and tracking progress.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --submit
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --print
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto  # Auto-detect and submit both parts
 */

import { execSync } from "child_process"
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "fs"
import { join } from "path"
import { config } from "dotenv"

// Load environment variables from .env file
config()

const AOC_SESSION =
  process.env.AOC_SESSION ||
  "<REDACTED>
const AOC_BASE_URL = process.env.AOC_BASE_URL || "https://adventofcode.com"
const RATE_LIMIT_MS = parseInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_MS || "60000", 10)

interface HarnessConfig {
  day: number
  part?: 1 | 2
  submit: boolean
  print: boolean
  auto: boolean
  year: number
  refreshStars: boolean
}

interface StarStatus {
  [day: number]: {
    part1: boolean
    part2: boolean
  }
}

const getCachePath = () => {
  const cwd = process.cwd()
  const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
  const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")
  return join(basePath, ".stars-cache.json")
}
const STARS_CACHE_FILE = getCachePath()

class AOCClient {
  private lastSubmissionTime = 0
  private sessionCookie: string

  constructor(sessionCookie: string) {
    this.sessionCookie = sessionCookie
  }

  async getStars(year: number, useCache = true): Promise<StarStatus> {
    // Try to load from cache first
    if (useCache && existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) {
      try {
        const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
        if (cached.year === year && cached.timestamp > Date.now() - 3600000) {
          // Cache is less than 1 hour old
          return cached.stars || {}
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // Cache invalid, continue to fetch
      }
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}`, {
        headers: {
          Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
        },
      })

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.warn(`Failed to fetch stars: ${response.statusText}`)
        return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
      }

      const html = await response.text()
      const status: StarStatus = {}

      // Parse HTML to find completed days
      // AoC calendar shows stars in various ways - try multiple patterns
      for (let day = 1; day <= 25; day++) {
        status[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }

        // Pattern 1: Look for calendar completion classes
        // Format: <span class="calendar-daycomplete"> or similar
        const completePatterns = [
          new RegExp(`calendar-daycomplete[^>]*>.*?day-${day}`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`calendar-verycomplete[^>]*>.*?day-${day}`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`day-${day}[^>]*calendar-daycomplete`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`day-${day}[^>]*calendar-verycomplete`, "gi"),
        ]

        let starCount = 0
        for (const pattern of completePatterns) {
          const matches = html.match(pattern)
          if (matches) {
            starCount = Math.max(starCount, matches.length)
          }
        }

        // Pattern 2: Check if the day link shows as completed
        // Look for "Both parts" or completion indicators near the day number
        const dayLinkPattern = new RegExp(
          `day-${day}[^<]*<[^>]*>(?:[^<]*Both parts|.*?\\*\\*)[^<]*`,
          "gi"
        )
        if (dayLinkPattern.test(html)) {
          starCount = Math.max(starCount, 2)
        }

        // Pattern 3: Check individual day page for completion
        // This is more reliable - check the actual day page
        try {
          const dayResponse = await fetch(
            `${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}`,
            {
              headers: {
                Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
              },
            }
          )
          if (dayResponse.ok) {
            const dayHtml = await dayResponse.text()
            // Look for "Both parts of this puzzle are complete" or similar
            if (
              dayHtml.includes("Both parts of this puzzle are complete") ||
              dayHtml.includes("You have completed both parts")
            ) {
              status[day].part1 = true
              status[day].part2 = true
              continue
            }
            // Check for part 1 completion
            if (
              dayHtml.includes("You have completed the first part") ||
              dayHtml.includes("Part 1 complete")
            ) {
              status[day].part1 = true
            }
          }
        } catch (error) {
          // If we can't check individual day, fall back to calendar parsing
        }

        // Use calendar parsing as fallback
        if (starCount > 0) {
          status[day].part1 = starCount >= 1
          status[day].part2 = starCount >= 2
        }
      }

      // Save to cache
      this.saveStarsCache(year, status)

      return status
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Error fetching stars: ${error}`)
      return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    }
  }

  private loadCachedStars(): StarStatus | null {
    if (!existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) return null
    try {
      const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
      return cached.stars || null
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }

  private saveStarsCache(year: number, stars: StarStatus): void {
    try {
      writeFileSync(
        STARS_CACHE_FILE,
        JSON.stringify({ year, stars, timestamp: Date.now() }, null, 2),
        "utf-8"
      )
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore cache write errors
    }
  }

  markStarComplete(year: number, day: number, part: 1 | 2): void {
    const cached = this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    if (!cached[day]) {
      cached[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }
    }
    cached[day][part === 1 ? "part1" : "part2"] = true
    this.saveStarsCache(year, cached)
  }

  async submitAnswer(
    year: number,
    day: number,
    part: 1 | 2,
    answer: string | number
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const client = this
    // Rate limiting
    const now = Date.now()
    const timeSinceLastSubmission = now - this.lastSubmissionTime
    if (timeSinceLastSubmission < RATE_LIMIT_MS) {
      const waitTime = RATE_LIMIT_MS - timeSinceLastSubmission
      console.log(
        `⏳ Rate limit: waiting ${Math.ceil(waitTime / 1000)} seconds...`
      )
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime))
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}/answer`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
          },
          body: `level=${part}&answer=${encodeURIComponent(String(answer))}`,
        }
      )

      this.lastSubmissionTime = Date.now()

      if (!response.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
        }
      }

      const html = await response.text()

      // Parse response
      if (html.includes("That's the right answer")) {
        // Mark as complete in cache
        this.markStarComplete(year, day, part)
        return { success: true, message: "✅ Correct answer!" }
      } else if (html.includes("That's not the right answer")) {
        const tooLow = html.includes("too low")
        const tooHigh = html.includes("too high")
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `❌ Wrong answer${
            tooLow ? " (too low)" : tooHigh ? " (too high)" : ""
          }`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You gave an answer too recently")) {
        const waitMatch = html.match(/You have ([\d]+) ([\w]+) left to wait/)
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `⏳ Too soon! ${
            waitMatch ? waitMatch[0] : "Please wait before submitting again."
          }`,
        }
      } else if (
        html.includes("You don't seem to be solving the right level")
      ) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "⚠️ Part 1 must be completed before Part 2",
        }
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "❓ Unknown response from server",
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Error: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }`,
      }
    }
  }
}

class AnswerParser {
  static parse(output: string): { part1?: string; part2?: string } {
    const result: { part1?: string; part2?: string } = {}

    // Try various patterns
    const patterns = [
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
      /^(\d+)$/m, // Just a number on its own line
    ]

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {

        break

    }

    const part2Patterns = [
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
    ]

    for (const pattern of part2Patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part2 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    return result
  }
}

class SolutionRunner {

          .map((p) => `  - ${p}`)

      )

    try {

      const solutionDir = join(codePath, "..")
      const output = execSync(`tsx "${codePath}"`, {
        cwd: solutionDir,

        stdio: "pipe",
      })

      return output
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(
        `Execution failed: ${error.message}\n${error.stdout || ""}\n${
          error.stderr || ""
        }`
      )
    }
  }
}

        process.exit(1)
      }

      console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part ${config.part}: ${answer}`)
      const result = await client.submitAnswer(
        config.year,
        config.day,
        config.part,
        answer
      )
      console.log(result.message)

      if (!result.success && result.message.includes("too recently")) {
        console.log("\n💡 Tip: Wait a minute before trying again")
      }

      if (result.success) {
        console.log(`\n🎉 Part ${config.part} complete!`)
      }
    } else {
      console.error("❌ --part required when using --submit")
      process.exit(1)
    }
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Fatal error:", error)
  process.exit(1)
})
```

Adding the refresh-stars flag and updating the main function:

```typescript
#!/usr/bin/env tsx

/**
 * Advent of Code Harness
 *
 * Automates running solutions, submitting answers, and tracking progress.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --submit
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --print
 *   tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto  # Auto-detect and submit both parts
 */

import { execSync } from "child_process"
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "fs"
import { join } from "path"
import { config } from "dotenv"

// Load environment variables from .env file
config()

const AOC_SESSION =
  process.env.AOC_SESSION ||
  "<REDACTED>
const AOC_BASE_URL = process.env.AOC_BASE_URL || "https://adventofcode.com"
const RATE_LIMIT_MS = parseInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_MS || "60000", 10)

interface HarnessConfig {
  day: number
  part?: 1 | 2
  submit: boolean
  print: boolean
  auto: boolean
  year: number
  refreshStars: boolean
}

interface StarStatus {
  [day: number]: {
    part1: boolean
    part2: boolean
  }
}

const getCachePath = () => {
  const cwd = process.cwd()
  const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
  const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")
  return join(basePath, ".stars-cache.json")
}
const STARS_CACHE_FILE = getCachePath()

class AOCClient {
  private lastSubmissionTime = 0
  private sessionCookie: string

  constructor(sessionCookie: string) {
    this.sessionCookie = sessionCookie
  }

  async getStars(year: number, useCache = true): Promise<StarStatus> {
    // Try to load from cache first
    if (useCache && existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) {
      try {
        const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
        if (cached.year === year && cached.timestamp > Date.now() - 3600000) {
          // Cache is less than 1 hour old
          return cached.stars || {}
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // Cache invalid, continue to fetch
      }
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}`, {
        headers: {
          Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
        },
      })

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.warn(`Failed to fetch stars: ${response.statusText}`)
        return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
      }

      const html = await response.text()
      const status: StarStatus = {}

      // Parse HTML to find completed days
      // AoC calendar shows stars in various ways - try multiple patterns
      for (let day = 1; day <= 25; day++) {
        status[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }

        // Pattern 1: Look for calendar completion classes
        // Format: <span class="calendar-daycomplete"> or similar
        const completePatterns = [
          new RegExp(`calendar-daycomplete[^>]*>.*?day-${day}`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`calendar-verycomplete[^>]*>.*?day-${day}`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`day-${day}[^>]*calendar-daycomplete`, "gi"),
          new RegExp(`day-${day}[^>]*calendar-verycomplete`, "gi"),
        ]

        let starCount = 0
        for (const pattern of completePatterns) {
          const matches = html.match(pattern)
          if (matches) {
            starCount = Math.max(starCount, matches.length)
          }
        }

        // Pattern 2: Check if the day link shows as completed
        // Look for "Both parts" or completion indicators near the day number
        const dayLinkPattern = new RegExp(
          `day-${day}[^<]*<[^>]*>(?:[^<]*Both parts|.*?\\*\\*)[^<]*`,
          "gi"
        )
        if (dayLinkPattern.test(html)) {
          starCount = Math.max(starCount, 2)
        }

        // Pattern 3: Check individual day page for completion
        // This is more reliable - check the actual day page
        try {
          const dayResponse = await fetch(
            `${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}`,
            {
              headers: {
                Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
              },
            }
          )
          if (dayResponse.ok) {
            const dayHtml = await dayResponse.text()
            // Look for "Both parts of this puzzle are complete" or similar
            if (
              dayHtml.includes("Both parts of this puzzle are complete") ||
              dayHtml.includes("You have completed both parts")
            ) {
              status[day].part1 = true
              status[day].part2 = true
              continue
            }
            // Check for part 1 completion
            if (
              dayHtml.includes("You have completed the first part") ||
              dayHtml.includes("Part 1 complete")
            ) {
              status[day].part1 = true
            }
          }
        } catch (error) {
          // If we can't check individual day, fall back to calendar parsing
        }

        // Use calendar parsing as fallback
        if (starCount > 0) {
          status[day].part1 = starCount >= 1
          status[day].part2 = starCount >= 2
        }
      }

      // Save to cache
      this.saveStarsCache(year, status)

      return status
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Error fetching stars: ${error}`)
      return this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    }
  }

  private loadCachedStars(): StarStatus | null {
    if (!existsSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE)) return null
    try {
      const cached = JSON.parse(readFileSync(STARS_CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"))
      return cached.stars || null
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }

  private saveStarsCache(year: number, stars: StarStatus): void {
    try {
      writeFileSync(
        STARS_CACHE_FILE,
        JSON.stringify({ year, stars, timestamp: Date.now() }, null, 2),
        "utf-8"
      )
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore cache write errors
    }
  }

  markStarComplete(year: number, day: number, part: 1 | 2): void {
    const cached = this.loadCachedStars() || {}
    if (!cached[day]) {
      cached[day] = { part1: false, part2: false }
    }
    cached[day][part === 1 ? "part1" : "part2"] = true
    this.saveStarsCache(year, cached)
  }

  async submitAnswer(
    year: number,
    day: number,
    part: 1 | 2,
    answer: string | number
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const client = this
    // Rate limiting
    const now = Date.now()
    const timeSinceLastSubmission = now - this.lastSubmissionTime
    if (timeSinceLastSubmission < RATE_LIMIT_MS) {
      const waitTime = RATE_LIMIT_MS - timeSinceLastSubmission
      console.log(
        `⏳ Rate limit: waiting ${Math.ceil(waitTime / 1000)} seconds...`
      )
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime))
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${AOC_BASE_URL}/${year}/day/${day}/answer`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            Cookie: `session=${this.sessionCookie}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
          },
          body: `level=${part}&answer=${encodeURIComponent(String(answer))}`,
        }
      )

      this.lastSubmissionTime = Date.now()

      if (!response.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
        }
      }

      const html = await response.text()

      // Parse response
      if (html.includes("That's the right answer")) {
        // Mark as complete in cache
        this.markStarComplete(year, day, part)
        return { success: true, message: "✅ Correct answer!" }
      } else if (html.includes("That's not the right answer")) {
        const tooLow = html.includes("too low")
        const tooHigh = html.includes("too high")
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `❌ Wrong answer${
            tooLow ? " (too low)" : tooHigh ? " (too high)" : ""
          }`,
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You gave an answer too recently")) {
        const waitMatch = html.match(/You have ([\d]+) ([\w]+) left to wait/)
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `⏳ Too soon! ${
            waitMatch ? waitMatch[0] : "Please wait before submitting again."
          }`,
        }
      } else if (
        html.includes("You don't seem to be solving the right level")
      ) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "⚠️ Part 1 must be completed before Part 2",
        }
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "❓ Unknown response from server",
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Error: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }`,
      }
    }
  }
}

class AnswerParser {
  static parse(output: string): { part1?: string; part2?: string } {
    const result: { part1?: string; part2?: string } = {}

    // Try various patterns
    const patterns = [
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
      /^(\d+)$/m, // Just a number on its own line
    ]

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part1 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    const part2Patterns = [
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
    ]

    for (const pattern of part2Patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part2 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    return result
  }
}

class SolutionRunner {
  static run(day: number, year: number): string {
    // Try different file naming patterns
    const dayStr = String(day).padStart(2, "0")
    const cwd = process.cwd()
    const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
    const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")

    const possiblePaths = [
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.ts`),
    ]

    const codePath = possiblePaths.find((p) => existsSync(p))

    if (!codePath) {
      throw new Error(
        `Solution file not found. Tried:\n${possiblePaths
          .map((p) => `  - ${p}`)
          .join("\n")}`
      )
    }

    try {
      // Run from the directory containing the solution file so relative paths work
      const solutionDir = join(codePath, "..")
      const output = execSync(`tsx "${codePath}"`, {
        cwd: solutionDir,
        encoding: "utf-8",
        stdio: "pipe",
      })

      return output
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(
        `Execution failed: ${error.message}\n${error.stdout || ""}\n${
          error.stderr || ""
        }`
      )
    }
  }
}

function parseArgs(): HarnessConfig {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2)
  const config: HarnessConfig = {
    day: 1,
    submit: false,
    print: true,
    auto: false,
    year: 2025,
    refreshStars: false,
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const arg = args[i]
    const nextArg = args[i + 1]

    switch (arg) {
      case "--day":
      case "-d":
        config.day = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--part":
      case "-p":
        config.part = parseInt(nextArg, 10) as 1 | 2
        i++
        break
      case "--submit":
      case "-s":
        config.submit = true
        break
      case "--print":
        config.print = true
        break
      case "--auto":
      case "-a":
        config.auto = true
        break
      case "--year":
      case "-y":
        config.year = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--help":
      case "-h":
        console.log(`
Advent of Code Harness

Usage:
  tsx harness.ts [options]

Options:
  --day, -d <number>     Day to run (1-25)
  --part, -p <number>    Part to run (1 or 2)
  --submit, -s           Submit answer to AoC
  --print                 Print answer (default: true)
  --auto, -a              Auto-detect and submit both parts
  --year, -y <number>     Year (default: 2025)
  --help, -h              Show this help

Examples:
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --print
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --submit
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto
        `)
        process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  return config
}

async function main() {
  const config = parseArgs()
  const client = new AOCClient(AOC_SESSION)

  console.log(`🎄 Advent of Code ${config.year} - Day ${config.day}\n`)

  // Check star status
  const stars = await client.getStars(config.year)
  const dayStars = stars[config.day] || { part1: false, part2: false }

  if (dayStars.part1 && dayStars.part2) {
    console.log("⭐ Both parts already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part1 && config.part === 1) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 1 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part2 && config.part === 2) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 2 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  // Run solution
  console.log("🚀 Running solution...")
  let output: string
  try {
    output = SolutionRunner.run(config.day, config.year)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ Failed to run solution: ${error}`)
    process.exit(1)
  }

  // Parse answers
  const answers = AnswerParser.parse(output)

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (config.print) {
    console.log("\n📊 Output:")
    console.log(output)
    console.log("\n📝 Parsed answers:")
    if (answers.part1) console.log(`  Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
    if (answers.part2) console.log(`  Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
  }

  // Submit if requested
  if (config.submit || config.auto) {
    if (config.auto) {
      // Submit both parts if we have answers
      if (answers.part1 && !dayStars.part1) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          1,
          answers.part1
        )
        console.log(result.message)

        if (result.success) {
          // Wait before submitting part 2
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, RATE_LIMIT_MS))
        }
      }

      if (answers.part2 && !dayStars.part2) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          2,
          answers.part2
        )
        console.log(result.message)
      }
    } else if (config.part) {
      const answer = config.part === 1 ? answers.part1 : answers.part2
      if (!answer) {
        console.error(`❌ No answer found for Part ${config.part}`)
        process.exit(1)
      }

      console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part ${config.part}: ${answer}`)
      const result = await client.submitAnswer(
        config.year,
        config.day,
        config.part,
        answer
      )
      console.log(result.message)

      if (!result.success && result.message.includes("too recently")) {
        console.log("\n💡 Tip: Wait a minute before trying again")
      }

      if (result.success) {
        console.log(`\n🎉 Part ${config.part} complete!`)
      }
    } else {
      console.error("❌ --part required when using --submit")
      process.exit(1)
    }
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Fatal error:", error)
  process.exit(1)
})
```

```typescript
        }
      } else if (html.includes("You gave an answer too recently")) {
        const waitMatch = html.match(/You have ([\d]+) ([\w]+) left to wait/)
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `⏳ Too soon! ${
            waitMatch ? waitMatch[0] : "Please wait before submitting again."
          }`,
        }
      } else if (
        html.includes("You don't seem to be solving the right level")
      ) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "⚠️ Part 1 must be completed before Part 2",
        }
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: "❓ Unknown response from server",
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Error: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }`,
      }
    }
  }
}

class AnswerParser {
  static parse(output: string): { part1?: string; part2?: string } {
    const result: { part1?: string; part2?: string } = {}

    // Try various patterns
    const patterns = [
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*1[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*1[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
      /^(\d+)$/m, // Just a number on its own line
    ]

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part1 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    const part2Patterns = [
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /part\s*2[:\s]+(\d+)/i,
      /Part\s*2[:\s]+(\S+)/i,
    ]

    for (const pattern of part2Patterns) {
      const match = output.match(pattern)
      if (match) {
        result.part2 = match[1]
        break
      }
    }

    return result
  }
}

class SolutionRunner {
  static run(day: number, year: number): string {
    // Try different file naming patterns
    const dayStr = String(day).padStart(2, "0")
    const cwd = process.cwd()
    const isInAdventDir = cwd.endsWith("advent-of-code")
    const basePath = isInAdventDir ? cwd : join(cwd, "advent-of-code")

    const possiblePaths = [
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${dayStr}.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.code.ts`),
      join(basePath, `${year}/day${day}.ts`),
    ]

    const codePath = possiblePaths.find((p) => existsSync(p))

    if (!codePath) {
      throw new Error(
        `Solution file not found. Tried:\n${possiblePaths
          .map((p) => `  - ${p}`)
          .join("\n")}`
      )
    }

    try {
      // Run from the directory containing the solution file so relative paths work
      const solutionDir = join(codePath, "..")
      const output = execSync(`tsx "${codePath}"`, {
        cwd: solutionDir,
        encoding: "utf-8",
        stdio: "pipe",
      })

      return output
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(
        `Execution failed: ${error.message}\n${error.stdout || ""}\n${
          error.stderr || ""
        }`
      )
    }
  }
}

function parseArgs(): HarnessConfig {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2)
  const config: HarnessConfig = {
    day: 1,
    submit: false,
    print: true,
    auto: false,
    year: 2025,
    refreshStars: false,
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const arg = args[i]
    const nextArg = args[i + 1]

    switch (arg) {
      case "--day":
      case "-d":
        config.day = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--part":
      case "-p":
        config.part = parseInt(nextArg, 10) as 1 | 2
        i++
        break
      case "--submit":
      case "-s":
        config.submit = true
        break
      case "--print":
        config.print = true
        break
      case "--auto":
      case "-a":
        config.auto = true
        break
      case "--year":
      case "-y":
        config.year = parseInt(nextArg, 10)
        i++
        break
      case "--refresh-stars":
      case "-r":
        config.refreshStars = true
        break
      case "--help":
      case "-h":
        console.log(`
Advent of Code Harness

Usage:
  tsx harness.ts [options]

Options:
  --day, -d <number>     Day to run (1-25)
  --part, -p <number>    Part to run (1 or 2)
  --submit, -s           Submit answer to AoC
  --print                 Print answer (default: true)
  --auto, -a              Auto-detect and submit both parts
  --year, -y <number>     Year (default: 2025)
  --help, -h              Show this help

Examples:
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 1 --print
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --part 2 --submit
  tsx harness.ts --day 1 --auto
        `)
        process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  return config
}

async function main() {
  const config = parseArgs()
  const client = new AOCClient(AOC_SESSION)

  console.log(`🎄 Advent of Code ${config.year} - Day ${config.day}\n`)

  // Check star status
  const stars = await client.getStars(config.year)
  const dayStars = stars[config.day] || { part1: false, part2: false }

  if (dayStars.part1 && dayStars.part2) {
    console.log("⭐ Both parts already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part1 && config.part === 1) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 1 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  } else if (dayStars.part2 && config.part === 2) {
    console.log("⭐ Part 2 already completed!")
    if (!config.submit && !config.auto) {
      process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  // Run solution
  console.log("🚀 Running solution...")
  let output: string
  try {
    output = SolutionRunner.run(config.day, config.year)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ Failed to run solution: ${error}`)
    process.exit(1)
  }

  // Parse answers
  const answers = AnswerParser.parse(output)

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (!answers.part1 && !answers.part2) {
    console.warn(
      "⚠️  No answers found in output. Make sure your solution prints 'Part 1: <answer>' and/or 'Part 2: <answer>'"
    )
  }

  if (config.print) {
    console.log("\n📊 Output:")
    console.log(output)
    console.log("\n📝 Parsed answers:")
    if (answers.part1) console.log(`  Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
    if (answers.part2) console.log(`  Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
  }

  // Submit if requested
  if (config.submit || config.auto) {
    if (config.auto) {
      // Submit both parts if we have answers
      if (answers.part1 && !dayStars.part1) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 1: ${answers.part1}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          1,
          answers.part1
        )
        console.log(result.message)

        if (result.success) {
          // Wait before submitting part 2
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, RATE_LIMIT_MS))
        }
      }

      if (answers.part2 && !dayStars.part2) {
        console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part 2: ${answers.part2}`)
        const result = await client.submitAnswer(
          config.year,
          config.day,
          2,
          answers.part2
        )
        console.log(result.message)
      }
    } else if (config.part) {
      const answer = config.part === 1 ? answers.part1 : answers.part2
      if (!answer) {
        console.error(`❌ No answer found for Part ${config.part}`)
        process.exit(1)
      }

      console.log(`\n📤 Submitting Part ${config.part}: ${answer}`)
      const result = await client.submitAnswer(
        config.year,
        config.day,
        config.part,
        answer
      )
      console.log(result.message)

      if (!result.success && result.message.includes("too recently")) {
        console.log("\n💡 Tip: Wait a minute before trying again")
      }

      if (result.success) {
        console.log(`\n🎉 Part ${config.part} complete!`)
      }
    } else {
      console.error("❌ --part required when using --submit")
      process.exit(1)
    }
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Fatal error:", error)
  process.exit(1)
})
```
