```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

// Parse red tile positions
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    
    if (area > maxArea) {
      maxArea = area
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 1: ${maxArea}`)

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Build set of green tiles (perimeter + interior)
const greenTileSet = new Set<string>()

// Add green tiles along edges connecting consecutive red tiles
function addLineBetween(p1: Point, p2: Point) {
  if (p1.x === p2.x) {
    // Vertical line
    const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
    const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
    for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++) {
      if (y !== p1.y || p1.x !== p2.x) { // Don't add the endpoints (they're red)
        greenTileSet.add(`${p1.x},${y}`)
      }
    }
  } else if (p1.y === p2.y) {
    // Horizontal line
    const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
    const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
      if (x !== p1.x || p1.y !== p2.y) { // Don't add the endpoints (they're red)
        greenTileSet.add(`${x},${p1.y}`)
      }
    }
  }
}

// Connect consecutive red tiles (including wrap-around)
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  const current = redTiles[i]
  const next = redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length]
  addLineBetween(current, next)
}

// Now fill the interior using flood fill
// Find bounding box
let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity
let minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  minX = Math.min(minX, tile.x)
  maxX = Math.max(maxX, tile.x)
  minY = Math.min(minY, tile.y)
  maxY = Math.max(maxY, tile.y)
}

// Use point-in-polygon to determine if a point is inside the loop
// We'll use ray casting algorithm
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  // Ray casting: count intersections with polygon edges
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Fill interior
for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
  for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++) {
    const key = `${x},${y}`
    // Skip if already red or green (on perimeter)
    if (redTileSet.has(key) || greenTileSet.has(key)) continue
    
    // Check if inside the loop
    if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) {
      greenTileSet.add(key)
    }
  }
}

// Combined set of valid tiles (red or green)
const validTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const key of redTileSet) validTileSet.add(key)
for (const key of greenTileSet) validTileSet.add(key)

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
let maxArea2 = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Determine rectangle bounds
    const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
    const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
    const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
    const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
    
    // Check if all tiles in rectangle are red or green
    let allValid = true
    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
      for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++) {
        const key = `${x},${y}`
        if (!validTileSet.has(key)) {
          allValid = false
          break
        }
      }
      if (!allValid) break
    }
    
    if (allValid) {
      const width = maxX - minX + 1
      const height = maxY - minY + 1
      const area = width * height
      if (area > maxArea2) {
        maxArea2 = area
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

// Parse red tile positions
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    
    if (area > maxArea) {
      maxArea = area
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 1: ${maxArea}`)

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
let maxArea2 = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Determine rectangle bounds
    const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
    const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
    const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
    const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
    
    // Check if all tiles in rectangle are red or green
    // Optimize: check boundary first for early exit
    let allValid = true
    
    // Check top and bottom edges
    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) {
        allValid = false
        break
      }
    }
    if (!allValid) continue
    
    // Check left and right edges
    for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) {
        allValid = false
        break
      }
    }
    if (!allValid) continue
    
    // If boundary is valid, check interior (for simple polygons, interior should be valid if boundary is)
    // But to be safe, we'll check a sample or all interior tiles
    // Actually, for a simple polygon, if all boundary tiles are valid, interior should be too
    // But let's verify with a few interior checks to be safe
    const width = maxX - minX + 1
    const height = maxY - minY + 1
    
    // If rectangle is small, check all tiles. Otherwise, sample interior
    if (width <= 10 && height <= 10) {
      // Small rectangle: check all
      for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
        for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
          if (!isValidTile(x, y)) {
            allValid = false
            break
          }
        }
        if (!allValid) break
      }
    } else {
      // Large rectangle: sample interior tiles
      // Check a grid of interior points
      const sampleX = Math.max(2, Math.floor(width / 10))
      const sampleY = Math.max(2, Math.floor(height / 10))
      for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x += sampleX) {
        for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y += sampleY) {
          if (!isValidTile(x, y)) {
            allValid = false
            break
          }
        }
        if (!allValid) break
      }
    }
    
    if (allValid) {
      const width = maxX - minX + 1
      const height = maxY - minY + 1
      const area = width * height
      if (area > maxArea2) {
        maxArea2 = area
      }
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 2: ${maxArea2}`)
```

Still timing out. Checking input size and optimizing the approach:

Optimizing: checking rectangle containment instead of every tile. With ~496 red tiles (~123k pairs) and large coordinates, checking every tile is too slow.

```typescript
// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  // Check all four corners
  if (!isValidTile(minX, minY) || !isValidTile(maxX, minY) ||
      !isValidTile(minX, maxY) || !isValidTile(maxX, maxY)) {
    return false
  }
  
  // Check if rectangle intersects any polygon edge (if it does, some tiles might be outside)
  // For each polygon edge, check if it intersects the rectangle
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    
    // Check if edge intersects rectangle boundary
    if (p1.x === p2.x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const ex = p1.x
      const ey1 = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const ey2 = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      
      // Edge intersects rectangle if it's inside x-range and overlaps y-range
      if (ex >= minX && ex <= maxX && ey1 <= maxY && ey2 >= minY) {
        // Check if edge goes through rectangle interior (not just boundary)
        if (ex > minX && ex < maxX && ey1 < maxY && ey2 > minY) {
          // Edge goes through interior - check if it's a valid green edge
          // This is fine, continue
        } else if (ex === minX || ex === maxX) {
          // Edge is on rectangle boundary - this is fine if it's green
          // But we need to check if any tiles are outside
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const ey = p1.y
      const ex1 = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const ex2 = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      
      if (ey >= minY && ey <= maxY && ex1 <= maxX && ex2 >= minX) {
        if (ey > minY && ey < maxY && ex1 < maxX && ex2 > minX) {
          // Edge goes through interior - fine
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Sample check: verify a few interior points are valid
  // If corners are valid and no edges cross, interior should be valid
  // But let's verify with a few samples
  const sampleX = Math.max(1, Math.floor((maxX - minX) / 4))
  const sampleY = Math.max(1, Math.floor((maxY - minY) / 4))
  
  for (let x = minX + sampleX; x < maxX; x += sampleX) {
    for (let y = minY + sampleY; y < maxY; y += sampleY) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) {
        return false
      }
    }
  }
  
  return true
}

let maxArea2 = 0
let checked = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    checked++
    if (checked % 10000 === 0) {
      console.error(`Checked ${checked} pairs, current max: ${maxArea2}`)
    }
    
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
    const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
    const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
    const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
    
    if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
      const width = maxX - minX + 1
      const height = maxY - minY + 1
      const area = width * height
      if (area > maxArea2) {
        maxArea2 = area
        console.error(`New max area: ${maxArea2} from (${p1.x},${p1.y}) to (${p2.x},${p2.y})`)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
      if (ey >= minY && ey <= maxY && ex1 <= maxX && ex2 >= minX) {
        if (ey > minY && ey < maxY && ex1 < maxX && ex2 > minX) {
          // Edge goes through interior - fine
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Sample check: verify a few interior points are valid
  // If corners are valid and no edges cross, interior should be valid
  // But let's verify with a few samples
  const sampleX = Math.max(1, Math.floor((maxX - minX) / 4))
  const sampleY = Math.max(1, Math.floor((maxY - minY) / 4))
  
  for (let x = minX + sampleX; x < maxX; x += sampleX) {
    for (let y = minY + sampleY; y < maxY; y += sampleY) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) {
        return false
      }
    }
  }
  
  return true
}
```

Answer is too high. The sampling approach misses invalid tiles. Checking all tiles, but optimizing `isValidTile`:

```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

// Parse red tile positions
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    
    if (area > maxArea) {
      maxArea = area
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 1: ${maxArea}`)

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  // Must check all tiles - sampling can miss invalid tiles
  // Optimize by checking boundary first for early exit
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  
  // For very large rectangles, this will be slow, but we need accuracy
  // Check boundary first
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // Now check interior - but skip if rectangle is too large
  // Actually, we need to check all tiles to be accurate
  // Let's check interior with early exit
  for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
    for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
    }
  }
  
  return true
}

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
```

```typescript
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)

  return inside
}

}

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
```
```typescript
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
```
  
```typescript
  // For large rectangles, check boundary first, then sample interior
  // Check all boundary tiles
```
```typescript
  try {
    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
    }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // For interior, use adaptive sampling based on size
  // If rectangle is small, check all tiles
  if (width <= 50 && height <= 50) {
    for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
      for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
        if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
  } else {
    // For large rectangles, use grid sampling
    // Sample every Nth tile, where N scales with rectangle size
    const stepX = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 20))
    const stepY = Math.max(1, Math.floor(height / 20))
    
    for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x += stepX) {
      for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y += stepY) {
        if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
    
    // For very large rectangles, we need to check more thoroughly
    // Check a grid pattern across the interior
    const gridSize = 10
    for (let gx = 0; gx < gridSize; gx++) {
      for (let gy = 0; gy < gridSize; gy++) {
        const x = minX + 1 + Math.floor((gx + 0.5) * (maxX - minX - 1) / gridSize)
        const y = minY + 1 + Math.floor((gy + 0.5) * (maxY - minY - 1) / gridSize)
        if (x < maxX && y < maxY && !isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
  }
  
  return true
}

let maxArea2 = 0
let pairsChecked = 0
const totalPairs = (redTiles.length * (redTiles.length - 1)) / 2
console.error(`Checking ${totalPairs} pairs of red tiles...`)

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    pairsChecked++
    if (pairsChecked % 1000 === 0) {
      console.error(`Checked ${pairsChecked}/${totalPairs} pairs, current max: ${maxArea2}`)
    }
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
    const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
    const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
    const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
    
    if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
      const width = maxX - minX + 1
      const height = maxY - minY + 1
      const area = width * height
      if (area > maxArea2) {
        maxArea2 = area
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
    }
```

```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

// Parse red tile positions
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    
    if (area > maxArea) {
      maxArea = area
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 1: ${maxArea}`)

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    // Avoid division by zero (shouldn't happen after yi === yj check, but be safe)
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  
  // For large rectangles, check boundary first, then sample interior

    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
    }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }

  // If rectangle is small, check all tiles
  if (width <= 50 && height <= 50) {
    for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
      for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
        if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
  } else {
    // For large rectangles, use grid sampling
    // Sample every Nth tile, where N scales with rectangle size
    const stepX = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 20))
    const stepY = Math.max(1, Math.floor(height / 20))
    
    for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x += stepX) {
      for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y += stepY) {
        if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }

        const y = minY + 1 + Math.floor((gy + 0.5) * (maxY - minY - 1) / gridSize)
        if (x < maxX && y < maxY && !isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
  }
  
    return true
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`Error in rectangleIsValid: ${e}`)
    return false
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

// Parse red tile positions
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    
    if (area > maxArea) {
      maxArea = area
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 1: ${maxArea}`)

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    // Avoid division by zero (shouldn't happen after yi === yj check, but be safe)
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  
  // For large rectangles, check boundary first, then sample interior
  // Check all boundary tiles
  try {
    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
    }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // For interior, use adaptive sampling based on size
  // If rectangle is small, check all tiles
  if (width <= 50 && height <= 50) {
    for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
      for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
        if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
  } else {
```
```typescript
    // For large rectangles, use more thorough grid sampling
    // Use a grid that scales with rectangle size but ensures good coverage
    const gridSize = Math.min(50, Math.max(10, Math.floor(Math.sqrt(width * height) / 100)))
    
    for (let gx = 0; gx <= gridSize; gx++) {
      for (let gy = 0; gy <= gridSize; gy++) {
        const x = minX + Math.floor(gx * (maxX - minX) / gridSize)
        const y = minY + Math.floor(gy * (maxY - minY) / gridSize)
        if (x >= minX && x <= maxX && y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
          if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
    return true
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`Error in rectangleIsValid: ${e}`)
    return false
  }
}

let maxArea2 = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]

    const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
    const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
    const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
    const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
```

```markdown
# Day 9: Movie Theater - Solution Log

## Problem Summary

Find the largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners.

### Part 1 ✅
- Find largest rectangle using any two red tiles as opposite corners
- Area = (|x2-x1| + 1) * (|y2-y1| + 1) (including endpoints)
- **Answer: 4755278336** ✅ CORRECT

### Part 2 ❌ (In Progress)
- Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
- Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles
- All tiles inside the loop are also green
- **Current attempts:**
  - 4596179031 - Too high (sampling missed invalid tiles)
  - 21894813 - Too low (skipped large rectangles > 10000x10000)
  - 39910560 - Too low (improved sampling but still missing valid rectangles)

## Solution Approach

### Part 1
- Simple: Check all pairs of red tiles, calculate area, find maximum
- O(n²) where n = number of red tiles (496 tiles = ~123k pairs)

### Part 2 Challenges
1. **Performance**: Need to check if all tiles in rectangle are valid
   - With large coordinates (90k+), rectangles can have millions of tiles
   - Checking every tile is too slow
   
2. **Validation Logic**:
   - Red tiles: from input list
   - Green tiles on perimeter: tiles on edges connecting consecutive red tiles
   - Green tiles inside: use point-in-polygon (ray casting)

3. **Current Implementation**:
   - `isValidTile(x, y)`: Checks if red, on edge, or inside polygon
   - `isOnEdge(x, y)`: Checks if point is on any polygon edge (excluding endpoints)
   - `isInsideLoop(x, y)`: Ray casting algorithm for point-in-polygon
   - `rectangleIsValid()`: Checks boundary tiles, then samples interior

### Issues Encountered

1. **Hanging/Timeout**: 
   - Initial implementation hung because checking all tiles in all rectangles was too slow
   - Fixed by adding size limits and sampling, but this caused incorrect answers

2. **Incorrect Answers**:
   - Sampling approach misses invalid tiles, leading to false positives
   - Size limits skip valid large rectangles
   - Need to balance thoroughness vs performance

### Next Steps

Need to find a more efficient way to check rectangle validity:
- Option 1: Precompute valid tile set (too large - billions of tiles)
- Option 2: Better sampling strategy (current approach)
- Option 3: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon more efficiently
- Option 4: Sort rectangles by potential area and check largest first

## Current Status

Working on optimizing the validation to be both fast and accurate.
```

```typescript
// Generate all rectangle candidates and sort by area (largest first)
type Candidate = { p1: Point; p2: Point; area: number }
const candidates: Candidate[] = []

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    candidates.push({ p1, p2, area })
  }
}

// Sort by area descending
candidates.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area)

let maxArea2 = 0
let checked = 0

for (const candidate of candidates) {
  checked++
  if (checked % 1000 === 0) {
    console.error(`Checked ${checked}/${candidates.length}, current max: ${maxArea2}, checking area: ${candidate.area}`)
  }
  
  // If we've found a valid rectangle and remaining candidates are smaller, we're done
  if (maxArea2 > 0 && candidate.area <= maxArea2) {
    break
  }
  
  const minX = Math.min(candidate.p1.x, candidate.p2.x)
  const maxX = Math.max(candidate.p1.x, candidate.p2.x)
  const minY = Math.min(candidate.p1.y, candidate.p2.y)
  const maxY = Math.max(candidate.p1.y, candidate.p2.y)
  
  if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
    maxArea2 = candidate.area
    console.error(`Found valid rectangle with area: ${maxArea2}`)
    // Continue checking in case there's a larger one (unlikely but possible)
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

// Parse red tile positions
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    
    if (area > maxArea) {
      maxArea = area
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 1: ${maxArea}`)

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    // Avoid division by zero (shouldn't happen after yi === yj check, but be safe)
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  // Check ALL tiles - sampling is unreliable
  // Optimize by checking boundary first for early exit
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // Check all interior tiles
  for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
    for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
    }
  }
  
  return true
}

let maxArea2 = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
    const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
    const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
    const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
    
    const width = maxX - minX + 1
    const height = maxY - minY + 1
    
    if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
      const area = width * height
      if (area > maxArea2) {
        maxArea2 = area
      }
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 2: ${maxArea2}`)
```

```markdown
# Day 9: Movie Theater - Solution Log

## Problem Summary

Find the largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners.

### Part 1 ✅
- Find largest rectangle using any two red tiles as opposite corners
- Area = (|x2-x1| + 1) * (|y2-y1| + 1) (including endpoints)
- **Answer: 4755278336** ✅ CORRECT

### Part 2 ❌ (In Progress)
- Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
- Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles
- All tiles inside the loop are also green
- **Current attempts:**
  - 4596179031 - Too high (sampling missed invalid tiles)
  - 21894813 - Too low (skipped large rectangles > 10000x10000)
  - 39910560 - Too low (improved sampling but still missing valid rectangles)
  - 4995773 - Found by checking all tiles, sorted by area (largest first)

## Solution Approach

### Part 1
- Simple: Check all pairs of red tiles, calculate area, find maximum
- O(n²) where n = number of red tiles (496 tiles = ~123k pairs)

### Part 2 Challenges
1. **Performance**: Need to check if all tiles in rectangle are valid
   - With large coordinates (90k+), rectangles can have millions of tiles
   - Checking every tile is too slow
   
2. **Validation Logic**:
   - Red tiles: from input list
   - Green tiles on perimeter: tiles on edges connecting consecutive red tiles
   - Green tiles inside: use point-in-polygon (ray casting)

3. **Current Implementation**:
   - `isValidTile(x, y)`: Checks if red, on edge, or inside polygon
   - `isOnEdge(x, y)`: Checks if point is on any polygon edge (excluding endpoints)
   - `isInsideLoop(x, y)`: Ray casting algorithm for point-in-polygon
   - `rectangleIsValid()`: Checks boundary tiles, then samples interior

### Issues Encountered

1. **Hanging/Timeout**: 
   - Initial implementation hung because checking all tiles in all rectangles was too slow
   - Fixed by adding size limits and sampling, but this caused incorrect answers

2. **Incorrect Answers**:
   - Sampling approach misses invalid tiles, leading to false positives
   - Size limits skip valid large rectangles
   - Need to balance thoroughness vs performance

### Next Steps

Need to find a more efficient way to check rectangle validity:
- Option 1: Precompute valid tile set (too large - billions of tiles)
- Option 2: Better sampling strategy (current approach)
- Option 3: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon more efficiently
- Option 4: Sort rectangles by potential area and check largest first

## Current Status

Working on optimizing the validation to be both fast and accurate.
```

```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height

    }

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions

  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (y !== p1.y || x !== p1.x) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (x !== p1.x || y !== p1.y) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Cache for point-in-polygon results to avoid recomputation
const insideCache = new Map<string, boolean>()

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (insideCache.has(key)) {
    return insideCache.get(key)!
  }
  
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    // Avoid division by zero
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  
  insideCache.set(key, inside)
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  const totalTiles = width * height
  
  // Skip extremely large rectangles (unlikely to be valid and very slow)
  if (totalTiles > 5000000) {
    return false
  }
  
  // Check ALL tiles - sampling is unreliable
  // Optimize by checking boundary first for early exit
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // Check all interior tiles
  for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {

    }
```

```typescript
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  const totalTiles = width * height
  
  // Skip extremely large rectangles (unlikely to be valid and very slow)
  // But allow larger ones if they might be valid
  if (totalTiles > 20000000) {
    return false
  }
  
  // Check ALL tiles - sampling is unreliable
  // Optimize by checking boundary first for early exit
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // Check all interior tiles
  for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
    for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
    }
  }
  
  return true
}

// Generate all candidates and sort by area (largest first)
// This allows us to find the answer faster and stop early
type Candidate = { i: number; j: number; area: number }
const candidates: Candidate[] = []

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    candidates.push({ i, j, area })
  }
}

candidates.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area)

let maxArea2 = 0
let checked = 0

for (const cand of candidates) {
  checked++
  if (checked % 10000 === 0) {
    console.error(`Checked ${checked}/${candidates.length}, max: ${maxArea2}, current: ${cand.area}`)
  }
  
  // Skip if this rectangle is smaller than our current max
  if (cand.area <= maxArea2) {
    continue
  }
  
  const p1 = redTiles[cand.i]
  const p2 = redTiles[cand.j]
  const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
  const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
  const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
  const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
  
  if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
    maxArea2 = cand.area
    console.error(`✓ Found valid rectangle: ${maxArea2} at candidate ${checked}`)
  }
}

console.log(`Part 2: ${maxArea2}`)
```

```typescript
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        if (!(y === p1.y && x === p1.x) && !(y === p2.y && x === p2.x)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        if (!(x === p1.x && y === p1.y) && !(x === p2.x && y === p2.y)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Point-in-polygon (ray casting)
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    if (yi === yj) continue // Skip horizontal edges
    
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true
  return false
}

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  // Check all tiles
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
    }
  }
  return true
}
```

```markdown
# Day 9: Movie Theater - Solution Log

## Problem Summary

Find the largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners.

### Part 1 ✅
- Find largest rectangle using any two red tiles as opposite corners
- Area = (|x2-x1| + 1) * (|y2-y1| + 1) (including endpoints)
- **Answer: 4755278336** ✅ CORRECT

### Part 2 ❌ (In Progress)
- Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
- Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles
- All tiles inside the loop are also green
- **Current attempts:**
  - 4596179031 - Too high (sampling missed invalid tiles)
  - 21894813 - Too low (skipped large rectangles > 10000x10000)
  - 39910560 - Too low (improved sampling but still missing valid rectangles)
  - 4995773 - Found by checking all tiles, sorted by area (largest first)

## Solution Approach

### Part 1
- Simple: Check all pairs of red tiles, calculate area, find maximum
- O(n²) where n = number of red tiles (496 tiles = ~123k pairs)

### Part 2 Challenges
1. **Performance**: Need to check if all tiles in rectangle are valid
   - With large coordinates (90k+), rectangles can have millions of tiles
   - Checking every tile is too slow
   
2. **Validation Logic**:
   - Red tiles: from input list
   - Green tiles on perimeter: tiles on edges connecting consecutive red tiles
   - Green tiles inside: use point-in-polygon (ray casting)

3. **Current Implementation**:
   - `isValidTile(x, y)`: Checks if red, on edge, or inside polygon
   - `isOnEdge(x, y)`: Checks if point is on any polygon edge (excluding endpoints)
   - `isInsideLoop(x, y)`: Ray casting algorithm for point-in-polygon
   - `rectangleIsValid()`: Checks boundary tiles, then samples interior

### Issues Encountered

1. **Hanging/Timeout**: 
   - Initial implementation hung because checking all tiles in all rectangles was too slow
   - Fixed by adding size limits and sampling, but this caused incorrect answers

2. **Incorrect Answers**:
   - Sampling approach misses invalid tiles, leading to false positives
   - Size limits skip valid large rectangles
   - Need to balance thoroughness vs performance

### Next Steps

Need to find a more efficient way to check rectangle validity:
- Option 1: Precompute valid tile set (too large - billions of tiles)
- Option 2: Better sampling strategy (current approach)
- Option 3: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon more efficiently
- Option 4: Sort rectangles by potential area and check largest first

## Current Status

**New Approach (Attempt 5):**
- Using test-driven development to iterate faster
- Created comprehensive test suite based on challenge examples
- Tests pass ✓ - validation logic is correct
- Fixed bug in `isOnEdge` - was using wrong logic to exclude endpoints
- **Current result: 4995773** - but this is wrong according to AoC
- Need to debug why we're not finding the correct larger rectangle

**Next Steps:**
1. Verify solution code matches test code exactly
2. Add more test cases to catch edge cases
3. Debug why larger valid rectangles aren't being found
4. Only submit when tests confirm correctness
```

```typescript
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  insideCache.set(key, inside)
  return inside
}

function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true
  return false
}

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
    for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
    }
  }
  return true
}
```

```typescript
// Generate candidates sorted by area
type Candidate = { i: number; j: number; area: number }
const candidates: Candidate[] = []

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    candidates.push({ i, j, area })
  }
}

candidates.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area)

console.log(`Checking top 1000 largest rectangles...`)
let maxArea = 0
let count = 0

for (const cand of candidates.slice(0, 1000)) {
  if (cand.area <= maxArea) break
  
  const p1 = redTiles[cand.i]
  const p2 = redTiles[cand.j]
  const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
  const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
  const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
  const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
  
  if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
    maxArea = cand.area
    console.log(`✓ Found valid: area=${maxArea}, (${p1.x},${p1.y}) to (${p2.x},${p2.y})`)
    count++
    if (count >= 10) break // Show first 10 valid ones
  }
}

console.log(`\nLargest valid rectangle found: ${maxArea}`)
```

```typescript
  return { x, y }
})

const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        if (!(y === p1.y && x === p1.x) && !(y === p2.y && x === p2.x)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        if (!(x === p1.x && y === p1.y) && !(x === p2.x && y === p2.y)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

const insideCache = new Map<string, boolean>()
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (insideCache.has(key)) return insideCache.get(key)!
  
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    if (yi === yj) continue
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  insideCache.set(key, inside)
  return inside
}

function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true
  return false
}

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
    for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
    }
  }
  return true
}

// Generate candidates sorted by area

}

candidates.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area)
```

```markdown
# Day 9: Movie Theater - Solution Log

## Problem Summary

Find the largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners.

### Part 1 ✅
- Find largest rectangle using any two red tiles as opposite corners
- Area = (|x2-x1| + 1) * (|y2-y1| + 1) (including endpoints)
- **Answer: 4755278336** ✅ CORRECT

### Part 2 ❌ (In Progress)
- Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
- Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles
- All tiles inside the loop are also green
- **Current attempts:**
  - 4596179031 - Too high (sampling missed invalid tiles)
  - 21894813 - Too low (skipped large rectangles > 10000x10000)
  - 39910560 - Too low (improved sampling but still missing valid rectangles)
  - 4995773 - Found by checking all tiles, sorted by area (largest first)

## Solution Approach

### Part 1
- Simple: Check all pairs of red tiles, calculate area, find maximum
- O(n²) where n = number of red tiles (496 tiles = ~123k pairs)

### Part 2 Challenges
1. **Performance**: Need to check if all tiles in rectangle are valid
   - With large coordinates (90k+), rectangles can have millions of tiles
   - Checking every tile is too slow
   
2. **Validation Logic**:
   - Red tiles: from input list
   - Green tiles on perimeter: tiles on edges connecting consecutive red tiles
   - Green tiles inside: use point-in-polygon (ray casting)

3. **Current Implementation**:
   - `isValidTile(x, y)`: Checks if red, on edge, or inside polygon
   - `isOnEdge(x, y)`: Checks if point is on any polygon edge (excluding endpoints)
   - `isInsideLoop(x, y)`: Ray casting algorithm for point-in-polygon
   - `rectangleIsValid()`: Checks boundary tiles, then samples interior

### Issues Encountered

1. **Hanging/Timeout**: 
   - Initial implementation hung because checking all tiles in all rectangles was too slow
   - Fixed by adding size limits and sampling, but this caused incorrect answers

2. **Incorrect Answers**:
   - Sampling approach misses invalid tiles, leading to false positives
   - Size limits skip valid large rectangles
   - Need to balance thoroughness vs performance

### Next Steps

Need to find a more efficient way to check rectangle validity:
- Option 1: Precompute valid tile set (too large - billions of tiles)
- Option 2: Better sampling strategy (current approach)
- Option 3: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon more efficiently
- Option 4: Sort rectangles by potential area and check largest first

## Current Status

**New Approach (Attempt 5):**
- Using test-driven development to iterate faster
- Created comprehensive test suite based on challenge examples
- Tests pass ✓ - validation logic is correct
- Fixed bug in `isOnEdge` - was using wrong logic to exclude endpoints
- **Current result: 4995773** - but this is wrong according to AoC
- Need to debug why we're not finding the correct larger rectangle

**Test Results:**
- ✓ Example test passes (area 24)
- ✓ Found rectangle 4995773 is valid according to our logic
- ✗ AoC says 4995773 is wrong
- Issue: Top 1000 largest rectangles are all invalid (or too slow to check)

**Hypothesis:**
- The correct answer might be in a medium-sized rectangle, not the largest ones
- Or there's a subtle bug in validation that only appears for certain cases
- Need to check more candidates, not just the largest

**Next Steps:**
1. Remove size limits and check all candidates (but optimize for speed)
2. Or check candidates in a different order (maybe by proximity?)
3. Verify the solution code matches test code exactly
4. Only submit when tests confirm correctness
```

```typescript
// Verify we're finding the true maximum by checking a sample of candidates
// and ensuring our found answer is actually the largest valid one

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        if (!(y === p1.y && x === p1.x) && !(y === p2.y && x === p2.x)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        if (!(x === p1.x && y === p1.y) && !(x === p2.x && y === p2.y)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}
```

```typescript
// Don't cache - it overflows for large rectangles
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    if (yi === yj) continue
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true
  return false
}

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  // Check boundary first for early exit
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // Check interior - but sample for very large rectangles
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  
  if (width * height > 10000000) {
    // Sample interior for very large rectangles
    const stepX = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 50))
    const stepY = Math.max(1, Math.floor(height / 50))
    for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x += stepX) {
      for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y += stepY) {
        if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Check all tiles for smaller rectangles
    for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
      for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
        if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
      }
    }
  }
  return true
}
```

```typescript
// Day 9: Movie Theater - Largest Rectangle with Red Tiles at Opposite Corners

const input = await Deno.readTextFile("input.txt")
const lines = input.trim().split("\n").filter(line => line.length > 0)

// Parse red tile positions
type Point = { x: number; y: number }
const redTiles: Point[] = lines.map(line => {
  const [x, y] = line.split(",").map(Number)
  return { x, y }
})

// Find largest rectangle with red tiles at opposite corners
// For any two red tiles at (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), they form opposite corners
// Area = |x2 - x1| * |y2 - y1|
let maxArea = 0

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    
    // Calculate rectangle area (including both endpoints)
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    
    if (area > maxArea) {
      maxArea = area
    }
  }
}

console.log(`Part 1: ${maxArea}`)

// Part 2: Rectangle must only contain red or green tiles
// Green tiles form a loop connecting consecutive red tiles, and fill the interior

// Build set of red tile positions
const redTileSet = new Set<string>()
for (const tile of redTiles) {
  redTileSet.add(`${tile.x},${tile.y}`)
}

// Store edges for perimeter checking
type Edge = { p1: Point; p2: Point }
const edges: Edge[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  edges.push({ p1: redTiles[i], p2: redTiles[(i + 1) % redTiles.length] })
}

// Check if a point is on a perimeter edge (green)
function isOnEdge(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const { p1, p2 } = edge
    if (p1.x === p2.x && p1.x === x) {
      // Vertical edge
      const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
      const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
      if (y >= minY && y <= maxY) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (!(y === p1.y && x === p1.x) && !(y === p2.y && x === p2.x)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    } else if (p1.y === p2.y && p1.y === y) {
      // Horizontal edge
      const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
      const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
      if (x >= minX && x <= maxX) {
        // On the edge, but not at endpoints (those are red)
        if (!(x === p1.x && y === p1.y) && !(x === p2.x && y === p2.y)) {
          return true
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

// Use point-in-polygon (ray casting) to determine if a point is inside the loop
// Don't cache - it overflows for large rectangles
function isInsideLoop(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let inside = false
  for (let i = 0, j = redTiles.length - 1; i < redTiles.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = redTiles[i].x, yi = redTiles[i].y
    const xj = redTiles[j].x, yj = redTiles[j].y
    
    // Skip horizontal edges (they don't intersect a horizontal ray)
    if (yi === yj) continue
    
    // Avoid division by zero
    const denom = yj - yi
    if (denom === 0) continue
    
    const intersect = ((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) &&
      (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / denom + xi)
    if (intersect) inside = !inside
  }
  return inside
}

// Check if a tile is valid (red or green)
function isValidTile(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const key = `${x},${y}`
  if (redTileSet.has(key)) return true // Red tile
  if (isOnEdge(x, y)) return true // Green tile on perimeter
  if (isInsideLoop(x, y)) return true // Green tile inside loop
  return false
}

// Find largest rectangle with red corners and only red/green tiles inside
// Optimization: Check if rectangle is entirely contained in polygon
// A rectangle is valid if all corners are valid AND rectangle doesn't cross polygon boundary

function rectangleIsValid(minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number): boolean {
  const width = maxX - minX + 1
  const height = maxY - minY + 1
  const totalTiles = width * height
  
  // Skip extremely large rectangles (unlikely to be valid and very slow)
  // But allow larger ones if they might be valid
  if (totalTiles > 20000000) {
    return false
  }
  
  // Check ALL tiles - sampling is unreliable
  // Optimize by checking boundary first for early exit
  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
    if (!isValidTile(x, minY) || !isValidTile(x, maxY)) return false
  }
  for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
    if (!isValidTile(minX, y) || !isValidTile(maxX, y)) return false
  }
  
  // Check all interior tiles
  for (let x = minX + 1; x < maxX; x++) {
    for (let y = minY + 1; y < maxY; y++) {
      if (!isValidTile(x, y)) return false
    }
  }
  
  return true
}

// Generate all candidates and sort by area (largest first)
// This allows us to find the answer faster and stop early
type Candidate = { i: number; j: number; area: number }
const candidates: Candidate[] = []

for (let i = 0; i < redTiles.length; i++) {
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    candidates.push({ i, j, area })
  }
}

candidates.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area)

let maxArea2 = 0
let checked = 0

for (const cand of candidates) {
  checked++
  if (checked % 10000 === 0) {
    console.error(`Checked ${checked}/${candidates.length}, max: ${maxArea2}, current: ${cand.area}`)
  }
  
  // Skip if this rectangle is smaller than our current max
  if (cand.area <= maxArea2) {
    continue
  }
  
  const p1 = redTiles[cand.i]
  const p2 = redTiles[cand.j]
  const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
  const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
  const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
  const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
  
  if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
    maxArea2 = cand.area
    console.error(`✓ Found valid rectangle: ${maxArea2} at candidate ${checked}`)
  }
}
```

```typescript
  for (let j = i + 1; j < redTiles.length; j++) {
    const p1 = redTiles[i]
    const p2 = redTiles[j]
    const width = Math.abs(p2.x - p1.x) + 1
    const height = Math.abs(p2.y - p1.y) + 1
    const area = width * height
    candidates.push({ i, j, area })
  }
}

candidates.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area)

let maxArea2 = 0
let checked = 0

for (const cand of candidates) {
  checked++
  if (checked % 10000 === 0) {
    console.error(`Checked ${checked}/${candidates.length}, max: ${maxArea2}, current: ${cand.area}`)
  }
  
  // Skip if this rectangle is smaller than our current max
  if (cand.area <= maxArea2) {
    continue
  }
  
  const p1 = redTiles[cand.i]
  const p2 = redTiles[cand.j]
  const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x)
  const maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x)
  const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y)
  const maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y)
  
  if (rectangleIsValid(minX, maxX, minY, maxY)) {
    maxArea2 = cand.area
    console.error(`✓ Found valid rectangle: ${maxArea2} at candidate ${checked}`)
  }
}

console.log(`Part 2: ${maxArea2}`)

```
